title: Imaging subtypes reveal distinct biological substrates and disability profiles in multiple sclerosis
title_zh: 成像亚型揭示多发性硬化症的不同生物学基础与功能障碍特征
abstract: Abstract Multiple sclerosis is characterized by marked biological heterogeneity that is only partly captured by conventional clinical phenotypes and age-at-onset categories. MRI can detect focal lesions, diffuse microstructural damage and atrophy, but these measures are usually considered separately. We therefore aimed to use Subtype and Stage Inference (SuStaIn), an unsupervised machine learning framework, to identify biologically meaningful MRI subtypes of multiple sclerosis and determine their associations with disability, age at onset, cognition, genetic susceptibility to more severe disease and relapse-independent progression. We applied SuStaIn to multimodal 3 T brain MRI data from 1017 patients with multiple sclerosis and 548 healthy controls. Imaging features included T2-hyperintense white matter lesion volume, mean diffusivity in white matter lesions and major white matter tracts, and cortical and deep grey matter volumes. Cognitive testing was available in 501 patients, genetic profiling in 650, and longitudinal clinical follow-up in 645 (median follow-up = 6.57 years). An independent validation cohort included 247 patients with multiple sclerosis and 141 healthy controls. SuStaIn identified four MRI subtypes: lesion-led (44%), cortex-led (23%), tract-led (23%) and deep grey matter/cerebellar-led (10%). Cortex-led and deep grey matter/cerebellar-led subtypes were enriched in progressive disease (47% and 56%), whereas lesion-led and tract-led subtypes were predominantly relapsing-remitting disease (66% and 71%; P < 0.001). The tract-led subtype was over-represented in paediatric-onset disease (38%) and under-represented in adult-onset disease (19%); the lesion-led subtype predominated in adult-onset disease (48%) and the deep grey matter/cerebellar-led subtype was more frequent in late-onset disease (14%) (P < 0.001). Expanded Disability Status Scale scores ≥4.0 and ≥6.0 were more frequent in cortex-led and deep grey matter/cerebellar-led disease than in lesion-led or tract-led disease (45.3% and 55.6% versus 34.3% and 31.9%, and 27.8% and 29.3% versus 20.0% and 18.7%; P < 0.001). Relapse-independent progression-free survival differed across subtypes (P = 0.04) and was 1.67 and 1.93 years shorter in cortex-led and deep grey matter/cerebellar-led disease, respectively, than in lesion-led disease (P < 0.001). Cognitive performance and genetic risk scores for multiple sclerosis severity did not differ across subtypes, but within each subtype advancing SuStaIn stage was associated with worse global and domain-specific cognitive performance (all P ≤ 0.030). The four-subtype structure was reproduced in the independent validation cohort. Multimodal MRI analysed with SuStaIn identified reproducible subtypes of multiple sclerosis with clinically meaningful differences in phenotype, age at onset, disability and relapse-independent progression, while cognitive impairment was related to advancing SuStaIn stage within each subtype. This framework may support biologically informed patient stratification and more mechanism-based prognostic and therapeutic approaches in multiple sclerosis.
abstract_zh: 摘要：多发性硬化症表现出显著的生物学异质性，而传统临床表型和发病年龄分类只能部分捕捉到这一点。磁共振成像（MRI）能够检测局灶性病灶、弥漫性微结构损伤和萎缩，但这些指标通常被单独考虑。为此，我们利用无监督机器学习框架Subtype and Stage Inference（SuStaIn）来识别具有生物学意义的多发性硬化症MRI亚型，并确定其与功能障碍、发病年龄、认知、对更严重疾病的遗传易感性以及与复发无关的进展之间的关联。我们将SuStaIn应用于来自1017名多发性硬化症患者和548名健康对照的多模态3T脑MRI数据。成像特征包括T2高信号白质病灶体积、白质病灶及主要白质束的平均弥散率，以及皮质和深层灰质体积。认知测试在501名患者中可用，遗传分析在650名患者中可用，纵向临床随访在645名患者中可用（中位随访期=6.57年）。独立验证队列包括247名多发性硬化症患者和141名健康对照。SuStaIn识别出四种MRI亚型：病灶主导型（44%）、皮质主导型（23%）、束主导型（23%）和深层灰质/小脑主导型（10%）。皮质主导型和深层灰质/小脑主导型亚型在进行性疾病中更为丰富（分别为47%和56%），而病灶主导型和束主导型亚型主要为复发-缓解型疾病（分别为66%和71%；P<0.001）。束主导型亚型在儿童发病疾病中比例较高（38%），成人发病疾病中比例较低（19%）；病灶主导型在成人发病疾病中占主导（48%），深层灰质/小脑主导型在晚发疾病中更为常见（14%）（P<0.001）。扩展残疾状态量表（EDSS）≥4.0和≥6.0的比例在皮质主导型和深层灰质/小脑主导型疾病中高于病灶主导型或束主导型疾病（分别为45.3%和55.6%对比34.3%和31.9%，以及27.8%和29.3%对比20.0%和18.7%；P<0.001）。不同亚型间的无复发进展生存期存在差异（P=0.04），皮质主导型和深层灰质/小脑主导型疾病的进展时间分别比病灶主导型短1.67年和1.93年（P<0.001）。认知表现和多发性硬化症严重程度的遗传风险评分在亚型间无显著差异，但在每个亚型内，SuStaIn阶段的推进与全局及特定认知领域表现的下降相关（所有P≤0.030）。四种亚型结构在独立验证队列中得以复制。利用SuStaIn分析的多模态MRI识别出可复制的多发性硬化症亚型，并在表型、发病年龄、功能障碍和与复发无关的进展方面具有临床意义的差异，而认知障碍与每个亚型内SuStaIn阶段的推进相关。该框架可支持基于生物学的患者分层以及更具机制性的预后和治疗方法。
